label: Medicare Advantage CMS-HCC risk adjustment
note: CMS names the models '2020 CMS-HCC' and '2024 CMS-HCC'; the labels V24 and V28 are the industry convention for those models and do not appear in the Rate Announcements. Non-PACE organizations only; PACE uses the 2017 model blends.

model_blend.unit: weight on each model's risk score (V24 = 2020 CMS-HCC, V28 = 2024 CMS-HCC)

normalization_factor.unit: divisor applied to the raw model risk score

coding_pattern_adjustment.unit: share by which normalized scores are reduced (statutory minimum 5.9% for 2019 and later)

diagnosis_sources_2027.value: Encounter data and FFS claims; diagnoses from unlinked chart review records excluded (except beneficiaries switching MA organizations); audio-only (modifiers 93/FQ) diagnoses excluded

ra24_blend.title: Announcement of Calendar Year (CY) 2024 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies
ra24_blend.excerpt: blend of 67% of the risk scores calculated with the current model (the 2020 model) and 33%

ra24_norm.title: Announcement of CY 2024 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies
ra24_norm.excerpt: 2024 CMS-HCC model (for non-PACE organizations), for blended risk score calculations: 1.015

ra25_blend.title: Announcement of CY 2025 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies
ra25_blend.excerpt: blending 67 percent of the risk score calculated using the updated 2024 CMS-HCC risk adjustment model with 33 percent

ra25_norm.title: Announcement of CY 2025 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies

ra26_blend.title: Announcement of CY 2026 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies
ra26_blend.excerpt: by using 100 percent of the risk score calculated using the 2024 CMS-HCC risk adjustment model

ra26_norm.title: Announcement of CY 2026 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies

ra26_ci.title: Announcement of CY 2026 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies
ra26_ci.excerpt: minimum coding pattern difference adjustment factor of 5.9 percent for 2019 and each year after

ra27_model.title: Announcement of CY 2027 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies
ra27_model.excerpt: CMS will continue to use the 2024 CMS-HCC risk adjustment model that was fully implemented for CY 2026

ra27_norm.title: Announcement of CY 2027 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies

ra27_ci.title: Announcement of CY 2027 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies
ra27_ci.excerpt: statutory minimum MA coding pattern difference adjustment factor of 5.90 percent

ra27_dx.title: Announcement of CY 2027 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies
ra27_dx.excerpt: exclude diagnoses from unlinked chart review records (CRRs), with an exception for beneficiaries who switch
